title: Growing Pets and Shared Household Food Spacing on Tailwise Autoship
content:
**Vet clinic coordination note — growing pets in a household on a shared food Autoship**

A growing pet in the household shortens the days between shipments of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household). The plans are read from the customer's Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans records, across all of the customer's pets.

1. When the customer holds a Kitten Wellness Plan or Puppy Wellness Plan in status active, 7 days are taken away.
2. When there is no such plan but the customer holds an Adult Cat Wellness Plan or Adult Dog Wellness Plan in status active enrolled no more than 365 days ago, 3 days are taken away.
3. Otherwise no days are taken away.

The age of an adult plan is the calendar days from its enrollment date to the day the value is worked out.

| Kitten or Puppy plan active | Adult plan active, enrolled no more than 365 days ago | Days taken away |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | 7 |
| No | Yes | 3 |
| No | No | none |

**Boundary (hypothetical).** An Adult Dog Wellness Plan enrolled 365 days ago: 3 days taken away. Enrolled 366 days ago: none. A Senior Cat Wellness Plan alone: none.
